foundation: Create or validate the Unreal Engine 5 C++ project. Establish reproducible Linux development build/test commands for the actual installed engine. Add base logging categories and minimal project configuration. Do not implement gameplay beyond what is needed to prove the build. Acceptance: project source is valid, build command is documented, and available build verification succeeds or an exact environment blocker is recorded.
interaction: Implement first-person movement/input and a reusable interaction interface/component suitable for doors, bed, package, locker, food and vehicle. Core interaction routing in C++; Blueprints only configure/present. Acceptance: player can focus and trigger at least two different interactable actor types through the same API; tests or focused verification cover interaction state.
world: Create one compact district/apartment blockout containing the required vertical-slice landmarks. Establish final-intent UE5 lighting early: apartment practicals, night street lighting and coherent exposure. Placeholder assets are allowed. Acceptance: all required locations exist in one navigable map and stable location identifiers are available to gameplay systems.
vehicle: Implement exactly one ordinary used car using Chaos Vehicles or existing valid repo approach. Provide enter/exit, accelerate/brake/reverse/steer, headlights, basic collision consequence and a game-facing cargo interface. Avoid coupling contract logic to Chaos internals. Acceptance: player can drive from apartment area to delivery locations and use cargo placement/retrieval.
contracts: Implement immutable data-driven contract definitions, runtime contract state and deterministic transitions. Support normal vs anonymous category, pickup/drop IDs, reward, time window/time limit, cargo ID, risk and extensible rules. Acceptance: automation tests prove accept -> pickup -> deliver, invalid early completion rejection, one-time payout event, fail state and data validation.
package: Implement a physical package actor/cargo representation that can be picked up through the common interaction system, carried or placed in vehicle cargo, and delivered only to the correct active drop point. Acceptance: pickup and delivery update runtime contract exactly once and package state cannot duplicate payout.
phone: Implement a minimal phone UI for normal jobs, anonymous offers, active objective and relationship/contract messages. UI reads domain state and emits commands; it must not own contract truth. Acceptance: player can accept/reject the required offers and inspect active objective without debug console.
normal_loop: Integrate the ordinary delivery loop in the real district: accept a normal job, drive to pickup, physically collect cargo, drive to destination, deliver, receive configured money. Acceptance: full path works from play start without editor intervention and duplicate completion cannot pay twice.
clock: Implement central simulated game time/day with explicit advancement, day/night query, timers/availability windows and sleep-time jump API. Do not derive progression from wall clock. Acceptance: deterministic tests cover advancement, day rollover and availability checks; world lighting can consume clock state.
needs: Implement slow hunger and fatigue progression with states Fed/Hungry/VeryHungry/Starving and Rested/Tired/Exhausted. One missed meal/late night should not be catastrophic. Starvation becomes lethal only after prolonged neglect. Acceptance: deterministic tests cover thresholds, recovery operations, mechanical modifier outputs and delayed starvation damage.
food_sleep: Add one believable food source and apartment bed interaction. Player can spend money to eat and can sleep to advance time/recover fatigue. Acceptance: both actions are physical/diegetic enough for the slice, update domain state, persist correctly and cannot create negative/invalid money/state.
save: Implement versioned USaveGame persistence for money, simulated time, needs, relationship placeholder state, active/completed contract state, relevant consequence flags and safe resume location/state. Acceptance: save/load round trip tests where practical plus gameplay smoke restore a stable state without duplicate rewards.
relationship: Implement one girlfriend contact and one planned interaction that can conflict with work. Persist a consequence when the player misses the plan because time passes elsewhere; reflect it via message or in-world interaction. No branching romance framework. Acceptance: choice emerges from schedule, not a morality popup, and save/load preserves the result.
anonymous: Add an optional anonymous contract that appears under configured timing/progression, pays much more than normal work, uses sparse private-offer presentation and completes through the same contract architecture. Include at least one high-risk modifier/hook such as changing destination or elevated encounter risk. Acceptance: accept/reject both work, completion/failure are stable, payout is once.
police: Implement one police-stop encounter prototype driven by ordinary trigger/context rather than omniscient guilt. Outcomes must include at least warning, fine and detention/arrest. Arrest can advance time, fail risky work, charge money and return player to a stable location. Acceptance: outcome semantics in C++ are testable and gameplay can exercise at least non-arrest and arrest paths.
hostile: Implement one hostile street encounter archetype with warning, pursue/attack and disengage/flee behavior. Keep combat minimal; multiple attackers should be dangerous. Losing may injure/rob the player and severe outcome can kill. Acceptance: player can avoid/flee in a valid path, losing produces configured consequence and AI does not remain permanently stuck.
death: Create unified death/incapacitation handling and wire at least violence plus hooks for collision/starvation. Define restart/resume semantics that preserve game stability. Acceptance: at least one reliable playable death path reaches consistent recovery/reload/game-over behavior and starvation can eventually invoke lethal damage.
art_pass: Apply one cohesive high-fidelity presentation pass to the slice: modern UE5 GI/reflections path, believable mixed urban light, apartment practicals, material consistency and restrained atmosphere. Do not add retro/VHS/cyberpunk treatment. Acceptance: the slice has coherent visual identity even where meshes remain placeholders and gameplay remains readable at night.
integration: Combine all required systems into one start-to-finish pre-prod path. Remove isolated debug-only dependency for normal play. Exercise ordinary work, food/sleep, relationship conflict, anonymous work, police/hostile consequences and persistence in one coherent lifecycle. Acceptance: full vertical-slice checklist in preprod-scope.md is executable without editor intervention.
gate: Run the pre-prod verification matrix, build/tests, main-loop smoke test and Beads triage. Fix P0 and main-loop P1 defects that can be resolved in scope. Create docs/reports/preprod-status.md with exact playable state, commands, verification, remaining blockers and known P0/P1 bugs. Acceptance: no fake completion, git working state is understood, and remaining open work is truthful.
